title: Unity C# Essentials
description: Learn introductory C# through Unity components, conventions and gameplay-focused examples.
overview: This focused course introduces the C# syntax and Unity concepts needed to read and modify small gameplay scripts. It connects variables, decisions and methods to GameObjects, components and the MonoBehaviour lifecycle. Programming Foundations I is recommended for complete beginners.
